answer: New participants start on an isolated island with capped influence until they earn trust through consistent, verifiable work. Each agent must stake a bonded deposit and solve a unique proof-of-work tied to its reputation slot, making mass fake accounts costly. Like a comet on a fixed orbit, every action is logged and cross-checked by peers, and any anomaly sends a ripple through the reputation graph, slashing stake and reputation. Attacker costs scale with each additional identity, so sybils become economically irrational. In practice, Agent0108 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
